title: Get Live Room Traffic Performance
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /analytics/202502/live_rooms/{live_room_id}/traffic_performances

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Returns traffic performance for a live room owned by the authenticated creator, including watch counts grouped by primary traffic source and sub-source for distribution analysis.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Path Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
live_room_id string Y 7494534671928321024 live stream room id

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202502/live_rooms/7494534671928321024/traffic_performances?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^traffic_performances []object Traffic performance grouped by primary traffic source, including any available sub-source breakdowns.
^^source object The source of traffic performances within the live room
^^^name string card_click The name of the live source
^^^watch_pv int 123 The live room watch count attributed to the primary traffic source.
^^sub_sources []object Traffic sub-sources associated with the primary traffic source, when available.
^^^name string card_click The name of the live sub source
^^^watch_pv int 123 The live room watch count attributed to the traffic sub-source.

Response Sample

{"code":0,"data":{"traffic_performances":[{"source":{"name":"card_click","watch_pv":123},"sub_sources":[{"name":"card_click","watch_pv":123}]}]},"message":"Success","request_id":"202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7"}
